entitybattle.configuration.conversionSec: Hold the converter for this many seconds; 0 converts instantly. Default: 5 seconds. The target must stay alive and nearby.
entitybattle.configuration.enableRChalle: Off by default. Enable to challenge supported native mobs with R. The converter remains available. Restart the game or server after changing this setting.
entitybattle.configuration.bossWorldMode: POKEMON_ENTITY: bosses automatically become Pokemon after native challenge requirements are met; NATIVE_MOB: retain the source mob and allow converter use. Both modes preserve dialogue and awakening requirements. Restart after changing this setting.
cobblemon.ability.entitybattletwilightdo: Reduces final damage by 20% until HP first reaches half. Twilight Siphon then lasts for this battle: no reduction, and attacking moves heal 10% of actual HP damage dealt.
cobblemon.ability.entitybattlesoulcovena: All damage to an allied active Twilight Lich is shared equally with all active allies with Soul Covenant.
cobblemon.battle.activate.entitybattletw: %1$s entered Twilight Siphon! Damage reduction is lost for this battle; attacks heal 10% of actual HP damage dealt.
entitybattle.boss_reward: Boss defeated: received a level 1 %s reward!
cobblemon.ability.entitybattlelamentrage: Losing a cumulative quarter of its opening maximum HP to opposing attacks grants sound moves 30% power for this battle. Indirect damage does not count; healing does not reset the counter.
cobblemon.battle.activate.entitybattlela: %1$s entered Lament Rage! Sound moves gain 30% power for this battle.
cobblemon.battle.damage.knightphantomtro: %1$s took reflected damage from a Knight Phantom Trophy!

cobblemon.ability.entitybattlecorecoolin: Once per battle, sets normal sunlight on its first effective entry. After surviving actual HP damage from an opposing Ice attack, cools permanently, clears normal sunlight, and lowers its Special Attack and Speed by one stage.
